title: ci(shipjs): add changelog to github releases
body:
**Summary**

This PR correctly resolves the changelog for monorepo packages and add it to github releases.

Where can we view the changelogs?

Hi, you can view changelogs for a package in its root directory, accessible from here: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/tree/master/packages.

Starting from the next release, you should also be able to view incremental changelogs in the [Releases](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/releases) page.
